blind.description: A low stylized stone wall segment made of dressed grey-brown masonry blocks with subtle moss accents between crevices. It features a central raised merlon/crenel section containing a narrow vertical arrow slit aperture and a peaked stone cap, flanked on both sides by lower wall sections topped with rounded stone coping caps. The geometry is solid, continuous, and stylized with bevelled block edges. The underside sits flat directly on the ground plane without any separate base plinth.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular strip of stone wall showing the rectangular top profile, with rounded coping on the left and right ends, lower recessed walkways/gaps, and a slightly wider, peaked square central capstone.
blind.height_vs_figure: The central pillar reaches about half the height of the figure (around 2.8 to 3 feet tall), while the side walls are about waist-high (around 2 feet tall); total length is about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.

notes: wall is slightly thinner and lower than nominal catalog dimensions but reads clearly as battlement
